{"command":"cd /home/ctfplayer/ctf_files && grep -icE 'bkupagent|afd4eop|heartbeat|8443|portal|vault|relay' fenwick_memdump.txt; grep -inE 'bkupagent|afd4eop|heartbeat|8443|portal|vault|relay' fenwick_memdump.txt | head; echo === freq ===; python3 - <<'EOF'
from collections import Counter
import re
lines=open('fenwick_memdump.txt').read().splitlines()
c=Counter()
for l in lines:
    p=l.split(' ',1)
    if len(p)>1: c[p[1]]+=1
print("unique strings:",len(c))
# strings appearing 2-9 times, not typical windows stuff
for s,n in c.most_common():
    if 2<=n<=9 and not re.search(r'(dll|exe|\.sys|HKEY|Microsoft|Windows|Privilege|Api|STATUS_|ERROR_|kernel|Temp|INetCache)', s, re.I):
        print(n, repr(s))
EOF"}
